description: This file defines the class TbMathArgumentValue, which provides methods to extract and convert argument values from message bodies and metadata within the Thingsboard rule engine.

classes.name: TbMathArgumentValue
classes.description: A class representing a numeric argument value with methods to create instances from message body, metadata, or string input.

methods.name: constant
methods.description: Creates a TbMathArgumentValue from a TbMathArgument's key.

methods.name: defaultOrThrow
methods.description: Returns a TbMathArgumentValue from a default value or throws an exception with an error message.

methods.name: fromMessageBody
methods.description: Extracts a value from a message body JSON node, converting it to double, with fallback to default.

methods.name: fromMessageMetadata
methods.description: Extracts a value from message metadata, converting it to double, with fallback to default.

methods.name: fromLong
methods.description: Creates a TbMathArgumentValue from a long value.

methods.name: fromDouble
methods.description: Creates a TbMathArgumentValue from a double value.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates a TbMathArgumentValue from a string, parsing it as a double.
